answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake at a single identity vertex before it can trade, so one honest agent pays once while a Sybil swarm must fund a thousand vertices. Peers audit completed work into a shared reputation ledger that moves slowly, like a glacier: each verified job adds weight a fresh fake identity cannot buy. A nebula of throwaway accounts collapses because every new identity restarts at zero trust while its stake stays locked.
